brief: A meeting scheduler where time flows as a river — free slots are calm water, meetings are bridges

dominant_strengths: Clean header with legible date control and a charming wave logo that hints at the river metaphor
Soft blue gradient backdrop and small color legend establish a calm, coherent palette baseline
dominant_weaknesses: The 'river' brief is entirely unrealized — no flowing water, no bridges, no meetings, just an empty hour grid
Massive vertical emptiness with a single column of timestamps wastes 90% of the canvas and lacks composition
Legend floats arbitrarily mid-canvas with no anchored relationship to schedule content or any visible events
fix_priorities: Render actual meetings as bridge shapes spanning a flowing water column to deliver the core metaphor
Introduce a horizontal river axis with day/participant lanes so time has spatial meaning beyond a left ruler
Anchor the legend to a sidebar and add motion/texture (ripples, currents) to differentiate free vs busy slots
Populate sample events to demonstrate hierarchy, density, and the urgent/important/routine color system
rationale.norman_balance: All three Norman layers are weak — visceral lacks the promised water imagery, behavioral lacks any interactive event affordance, and reflective offers no narrative payoff.
rationale.intent_fit: The design names the metaphor but fails to embody it, presenting a generic empty timeline rather than a river-and-bridges scheduler.
